summary: The migrated WinUI 3 app builds cleanly (0 errors, 88 warnings) but is NON-FUNCTIONAL: it cannot be launched. Both 'winapp run <build-output>' and 'dotnet run' fail at package registration with error 0x80080204. Because the app never launches, every one of the 8 scenarios is unreachable and fails. The original UWP app launched successfully and served as ground truth.

blocking_defect.detail: EntryPoint="BackgroundTask.GeofenceBackgroundTask" is declared without a corresponding ActivatableClassId in windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer. A non-audio background task must register its in-process server activatable class. Package registration is rejected, so the app cannot start.
blocking_defect.impact: App fails to register/launch entirely — no scenario is reachable.

uwp_capture_note: Original UWP app launched successfully (Release build, PID 17492, windowTitle 'Geolocation C# Sample'). A golden screenshot of the default view (Scenario 1) was captured. Per-scenario navigation and per-control actuation of the ORIGINAL UWP app could not be driven on this host: the legacy UWP CoreWindow does not expose its UIA content tree to external automation (winapp inspect/search/invoke return only the top-level Pane), and synthetic Win32 mouse/keyboard input did not reach the session (GetCursorPos stayed at 0,0). This limits the UWP behavioral baseline but does not affect the verdict, since the migrated app never launched.
